svg.aria-label: Architecture of Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. Maven, npm and Docker clients and a browser send requests to one static binary. Inside it a request passes the listeners, one main port plus one port per Docker repository, then a Host gate that answers 403 unless the Host header names the server, then sign in and permissions. Clients send Basic credentials or a token. A request then reaches the embedded interface with the manual, the REST API, which answers 501 for refused areas, or the read path for Maven, npm, Docker and plain files. The read path and the REST API look files up in an SQLite index. Sign in reads users, roles and privileges from state.sqlite. On disk the binary reads the file blob stores of an existing install in place and never writes them. Its own data directory holds config.json, repositories.json, state.sqlite with users, roles, privileges and LDAP connections, index.sqlite and catalog.sqlite, which scan fills from the blob stores. Nothing reads catalog.sqlite yet.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry architecture
